mapper.sql: est02_pf_contract_id AS pf_contract_id, est02_borrower AS borrower, est02_project_site_nm AS project_site_name, est02_project_site_addr AS project_site_addr, est02_pf_fee_type_id AS pf_fee_type_id, est01_fee_cd AS fee_code, f_cdnm('EstPfFeeCode', est01_fee_cd, est02_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS fee_name, est02_start_date AS start_date, est02_close_date AS close_date, est02_manager_id AS manager_id, emp01_kor_nm AS manager_name, ( f_get_empTrans(est02_manager_id, est02_start_date::date, 'org_code_nm') ||' '|| emp01_kor_nm ||' ('|| emp01_office_telno ||', '|| emp01_email_addr ||')' ) AS manager_info, f_get_emptrans(est02_manager_id, est02_start_date, 'org_code_id') AS manager_org_id, est02_plan AS plan, est02_plan_appr_id AS plan_appr_id, ( SELECT f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) FROM apr01_appr WHERE apr01_appr_id = est02_plan_appr_id ) AS plan_appr_status_name, est02_result_appr_id AS result_appr_id, ( SELECT f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) FROM apr01_appr WHERE apr01_appr_id = est02_result_appr_id ) AS result_appr_status_name
FROM est02_pf_contract INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = est02_manager_id LEFT OUTER JOIN est01_pf_fee_type ON est01_pf_fee_type_id = est02_pf_fee_type_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE 1=1 AND est02_company_id = #{companyId} AND #{startDate} BETWEEN est02_start_date AND COALESCE(est02_close_date, TO_DATE('29991231', 'yyyyMMdd')) AND UPPER(CONCAT(est02_borrower, est02_project_site_nm, f_cdnm('EstPfFeeCode', est01_fee_cd, est02_company_id, f_sysdate()))) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO est02_pf_contract (est02_pf_contract_id, est02_company_id, est02_pf_fee_type_id, est02_manager_id, est02_borrower, est02_project_site_nm, est02_project_site_addr, est02_start_date, est02_close_date, est02_plan) VALUES (#{r.pfContractId}, #{companyId}, #{r.pfFeeTypeId}, #{r.managerId}, #{r.borrower}, #{r.projectSiteName}, #{r.projectSiteAddr}, #{r.startDate}, #{r.closeDate}, #{r.plan})
mapper.update: UPDATE est02_pf_contract SET est02_pf_fee_type_id = #{r.pfFeeTypeId}, est02_manager_id = #{r.managerId}, est02_borrower = #{r.borrower}, est02_project_site_nm = #{r.projectSiteName}, est02_project_site_addr = #{r.projectSiteAddr}, est02_start_date = #{r.startDate}, est02_close_date = #{r.closeDate}, est02_plan = #{r.plan} WHERE est02_pf_contract_id = #{r.pfContractId} AND est02_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.select: SELECT est03_pf_history_id FROM est03_pf_history WHERE est03_pf_contract_id IN #{pfContractId}
